verdict.rationale: GitHub docs claim broad agentic coding ability—editing codebases, debugging, and even 'handling complex rebases' (implying merge-conflict resolution)—but no explicit mention of test-writing, lint-fixing, or dependency updates. Multiple hands-on community reports contradict reliable agentic use, citing it getting 'stuck in a loop of errors,' being 'terrible at agentic stuff,' 'jumps right into coding and gets stuck in spaghetti code,' and even destructively deleting files during file operations.
